title: Install the precompiled Máquina PR advisory
objective: Run candidate Swift and diff validation separately, then evaluate the trusted base contract with an immutable Máquina Action whose Linux binary was compiled from a recorded source commit.
acceptance_criteria: Candidate swift build runs on a macOS runner and reports a bounded success or failure conclusion.
git diff --check evaluates the pull-request base-to-head range.
The advisory checks out policy only from the trusted base SHA.
The advisory Action is pinned to immutable commit 6d78714a682a73ec52248a4f804f0997139eb6f1 and requires no Go toolchain or Máquina source checkout.
Sanitized evidence is uploaded without granting write permissions or publishing comments.
